summary: Aspen Insurance Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 furnishing unaudited first-half 2026 financial highlights (gross written premiums $2,423.6M; net loss available to ordinary shareholders $75.7M; combined ratio 96.7%) plus pro forma statements tied to internal integration transactions completed August 14, 2026. The filing marks current-period performance disclosure under Rule 13a-16, not a transaction. It references the prior February 24, 2026 acquisition by a Sompo International indirect subsidiary, and notes a $27.0M AFS-to-trading reclassification. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor action are presented; the item is informational only.
